reasonNotCreated: dispatch: Do not create the job. leave_behind: planner creates the job.

job.name: county-ledger-heartbeat
job.description: Keep county_ledger_snapshot younger than Command Center LEDGER_STALE_AFTER_MS (15 minutes).
job.scheduleRationale: SLA is 15 minutes. Ten-minute period leaves a five-minute margin for a 409 (recompute_in_progress) retry or a slow skip-probe run. A 15-minute cron would meet the threshold only on an instantaneous success and would show STALE after any delay.

headers.Authorization: Bearer <SERVICE_API_KEY from secret SERVICE_API_KEY; never stored in this spec>

http.bodyRequired: Cloud Run frontend returns 411 Length Required on a bare POST with no body before Express sees the route. Probe and the job must send -d '{}' / --message-body={}.

authShape.whyNotOidc: POST /api/county-ledger/recompute is gated by requireServiceToken, which compares Authorization Bearer to SERVICE_API_KEY. Cloud Scheduler OIDC writes an identity token into that same Authorization header and would 401. Cloud Run IAM on cortex-api is allUsers roles/run.invoker (bindings[0].members), so OIDC is not required to invoke.

timeouts.whyProbeSkipOnTheJob: L18 full materialize was 1072.2s. Serving Cloud Run timeoutSeconds is 300 and RECOMPUTE_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS is 240000. A scheduled POST without probe=skip will 504 / statement-timeout rather than refresh computedAt. probe=skip is the only POST that can finish inside the serving timeout today. Raising Cloud Run timeout is a separate planner change, not this spec.

sla.staleThresholdSource: hauska-map 9477a8f LEDGER_STALE_AFTER_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000; live CC bundle assets/index-CRBvzuKb.js has data-testid manifest-stale-banner and manifest-computed-at
sla.whatFailsWhenItMisses: Command Center County Manifest shows pill 'manifest stale' and banner 'STALE — materialized at <computedAt> (showing snapshot, not a live recompute).' GET /api/county-ledger stays HTTP 200 with growing summary.materializationAgeMs. The miss is visible honesty, not an HTTP error.

liveProofThisProbe.ccBanner: STALE — materialized at 2026-08-21T18:05:57.209Z (showing snapshot, not a live recompute).

whatBypassesIt: manual POST /api/county-ledger/recompute?probe=skip with Authorization Bearer SERVICE_API_KEY and body {} (named by dispatch)
manual POST /api/county-ledger/recompute (full probes) with the same auth — a bypass of the scheduler, but it will not finish inside Cloud Run 300s today
countyLedgerMaterializeCli --apply from a laptop (full probes, not bound by Cloud Run timeout)
GET /api/county-ledger does not rematerialize; it only stamps servedAt

contention.schedulerRetry: enable Cloud Scheduler retry; a 409 is contention, not a missing route

targetRevisionAtSpec.note: digest from revision spec.containers[0].image / status.imageDigest, not the service template tag
